review_limits: No paper draft was supplied for this review run, so claims-vs-code could not be evaluated against manuscript prose.

The uncommitted diff only modifies replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py (a Python table-extraction and reproduction-checking utility) and makes no changes to sample construction, linkage, or econometric specifications under identification.

The new branches for missing committed tables (not committed.exists()) were verified by static trace because all 7 tables currently exist in linkage_tables/ and the review runs in a read-only sandbox.
structured_output.summary: The uncommitted diff in replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py cleanly handles newly added tables in TABLES that do not yet have a committed reference copy in linkage_tables/. Instead of crashing with FileNotFoundError in check_reproduction() or main(), the script now flags the missing committed table, sets the exit status to non-zero, and extracts the tabular block from the regenerated file when --regenerated is provided. Read-only verification with --check and --regenerated confirmed all seven tables reproduce byte-for-byte. No defects were found.

verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:67-75 checks regen.exists() and then committed.exists() before calling sha256(committed), printing 'NOT COMMITTED', setting ok = False, and continuing without raising FileNotFoundError.
verified_clean.item: Graceful handling of uncommitted tables in check_reproduction()

verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:138-152,166 sets failed = True when committed.exists() is false, prints 'MISSING' and continues if args.regenerated is absent or the regenerated file is missing, and otherwise reads regen and passes ref = regen to tabular(text, ref).
verified_clean.item: Fallback extraction from --regenerated and non-zero exit code when a committed table is absent in main()

verified_clean.evidence: replication/extract_deaglan_tables.py:153 guards the text-diff check with 'if args.regenerated and committed.exists():', avoiding unbound ctext references and redundant reads when committed is missing.
verified_clean.item: Interaction between the not-committed branch and the existing --regenerated comparison branch

verified_clean.item: Read-only execution of extract_deaglan_tables.py --check against committed and regenerated tables

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
